title: 生物濾池污水處理~Biological trickling-filter wastewater treatment
focus: 布水、生物膜與後段沉澱的串連~Connecting distribution, biofilm and downstream settling
summary: 生物濾池讓水流經附著生物膜的介質；布水與通風維持反應，脫落生物膜仍需處理。學徒從預沉走到回流、傳質和終沉，區分過濾與生物轉化。~Trickling filters pass water over attached-film media; distribution and ventilation support reaction while sloughed biomass still needs treatment. Follow primary settling, recycle, transport and final settling, distinguishing filtration from conversion.

units.title: 初沉前有機負荷：污染負荷與採樣邊界~Organic load before primary settling: Pollutant load and sampling boundary
units.mechanism: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「初沉前有機負荷」觀察此因果關係。~Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at organic load before primary settling.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
units.verify: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「初沉前有機負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for organic load before primary settling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。~Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
units.practice: 先點選「初沉前有機負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the organic load before primary settling measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 介質前顆粒保護：表面溢流率與沉降分離~Particle protection before media: Surface loading and settling separation
units.mechanism: 理想沉澱中顆粒沉速相對於表面溢流率決定是否捕集；增加深度主要改變停留與污泥儲存，不能取代表面積。本單元在「介質前顆粒保護」觀察此因果關係。~In ideal settling, particle settling speed relative to surface overflow rate governs capture; greater depth changes retention and sludge storage but cannot replace surface area. Examine this relationship at particle protection before media.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q=6000 m³/d、表面積 A=300 m²。公式 v0=Q/A；代入 6000/300 = 20 m/d。適用邊界：理想離散顆粒近似；絮凝、污泥濃縮、風與短流另行檢核。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q=6000 m³/d and surface area A=300 m². Formula v0=Q/A; substitution 6000/300 = 20 m/d. Boundary: Ideal discrete-particle approximation; flocculation, thickening, wind and short-circuiting need separate checks.
units.verify: 用沉降柱與進出水SS比對捕集，不把水清澈當溶解物已去除。在離線場景為「介質前顆粒保護」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare a settling-column test and inlet/outlet SS; clear water does not prove dissolved contaminants were removed. Build an offline evidence table for particle protection before media; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 排泥不良會讓泥層抬升，造成出水固體增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Poor sludge withdrawal raises the sludge blanket and increases effluent solids. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要把池挖深就能任意增加沉澱流量。~Making a tank deeper permits unlimited settling flow.
units.practice: 先點選「介質前顆粒保護」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把面積加至400 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15 m/d。與基準 20 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the particle protection before media measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only area to400 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15 m/d. Compare with baseline 20 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 旋轉布水與回流水量：濾床水力負荷與布水~Rotating distribution/recycle flow: Trickling-filter hydraulic loading
units.mechanism: 生物濾池需把液體分配到填料表面，回流可改善潤濕但增加水力負荷；過濕會降低通風。本單元在「旋轉布水與回流水量」觀察此因果關係。~A trickling filter distributes liquid over media; recycle improves wetting but raises hydraulic loading, and excessive wetness restricts ventilation. Examine this relationship at rotating distribution/recycle flow.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水1000、回流500 m³/d、濾床面積250 m²。公式 HL=(Q+Qr)/A；代入 (1000+500)/250 = 6 m/d。適用邊界：平均布水量，不能描述局部乾區或噴嘴失效。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: influent1000 and recycle500 m³/d with bed area250 m². Formula HL=(Q+Qr)/A; substitution (1000+500)/250 = 6 m/d. Boundary: Mean loading; local dry areas and nozzle failure are not resolved.
units.verify: 比較接水杯的分布均勻度、噴臂速度與床底通風。在離線場景為「旋轉布水與回流水量」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare catch-cup distribution, distributor speed and underdrain ventilation. Build an offline evidence table for rotating distribution/recycle flow; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 布水孔堵塞會讓部分填料乾燥而其他區域積水。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Clogged nozzles dry some media while flooding others. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總進水量正常就保證每個填料面都被均勻潤濕。~Normal total flow guarantees uniformly wetted media.
units.practice: 先點選「旋轉布水與回流水量」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把回流增加到1000 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 8 m/d。與基準 6 m/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the rotating distribution/recycle flow measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only recycle to1000 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 8 m/d. Compare with baseline 6 m/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 生物膜有效表面負荷：生物膜表面負荷~Effective film surface loading: Biofilm surface loading
units.mechanism: 附著生長系統以每天負荷除以可用面積評估負擔；有機物與氨氮必須分開計算。本單元在「生物膜有效表面負荷」觀察此因果關係。~Attached-growth loading is daily load divided by usable area; organic matter and ammonia must be accounted for separately. Examine this relationship at effective film surface loading.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：有機負荷60 kg/d、可用生物面積20000 m²。公式 LA=1000L/A；代入 1000*60/20000 = 3 g/(m²·d)。適用邊界：假想平均表面負荷，未計溫度、氧限制與生物膜動力學。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: organic load60 kg/d and usable biological area20000 m². Formula LA=1000L/A; substitution 1000*60/20000 = 3 g/(m²·d). Boundary: Hypothetical mean surface load; temperature, oxygen limitation and kinetics excluded.
units.verify: 量測進出水負荷並將其與載體面積和水溫一起報告。在離線場景為「生物膜有效表面負荷」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure influent/effluent loads and report them alongside carrier area and water temperature. Build an offline evidence table for effective film surface loading; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 外層異營菌搶氧可使同面積硝化能力下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Outer heterotrophs can consume oxygen and reduce nitrification at the same area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 所有污染物都可用同一表面負荷限值處理。~One surface-loading limit applies to every pollutant.
units.practice: 先點選「生物膜有效表面負荷」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有機負荷改成90 kg/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4.5 g/(m²·d)。與基準 3 g/(m²·d)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the effective film surface loading measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only organic load to90 kg/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4.5 g/(m²·d). Compare with baseline 3 g/(m²·d) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 液膜與生物膜傳質：生物膜擴散距離~Liquid/biological-film transport: Biofilm diffusion length
units.mechanism: 擴散特徵時間與膜厚平方成正比；生物膜加厚會增加質傳時間，不必然增加有效反應量。本單元在「液膜與生物膜傳質」觀察此因果關係。~Characteristic diffusion time scales with thickness squared; a thicker film lengthens transport and need not increase effective reaction. Examine this relationship at liquid/biological-film transport.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：膜厚L=0.0005 m、有效擴散係數D=1e-9 m²/s。公式 tdiff=L²/D；代入 0.0005**2/1e-9 = 250 s。適用邊界：無反應的量級估計；反應—擴散與孔隙結構需更完整模型。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: film thicknessL=0.0005 m and effective diffusivityD=1e-9 m²/s. Formula tdiff=L²/D; substitution 0.0005**2/1e-9 = 250 s. Boundary: Nonreactive timescale estimate; reaction-diffusion and porosity need a fuller model.
units.verify: 比較膜厚、溶氧剖面與表面負荷，不能僅稱量載體。在離線場景為「液膜與生物膜傳質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare thickness, oxygen profiles and surface loading rather than carrier mass alone. Build an offline evidence table for liquid/biological-film transport; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 厚膜內層缺氧與脫落會讓出水SS升高。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Oxygen-poor thick inner layers and sloughing can raise effluent SS. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 生物膜厚度加倍就必定處理量加倍。~Doubling biofilm thickness necessarily doubles treatment.
units.practice: 先點選「液膜與生物膜傳質」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把膜厚減成0.00025 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 62.5 s。與基準 250 s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the liquid/biological-film transport measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only film thickness to0.00025 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 62.5 s. Compare with baseline 250 s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 回流改善濕潤與水力代價：內回流與水力負荷~Recycle wetting/hydraulic tradeoff: Internal recirculation and hydraulic load
units.mechanism: 回流把反應物帶回前段，也增加管線與反應區通過量；回流率不是污染物去除率。本單元在「回流改善濕潤與水力代價」觀察此因果關係。~Recirculation returns reactants upstream while increasing pipe and zone throughput; recycle ratio is not removal efficiency. Examine this relationship at recycle wetting/hydraulic tradeoff.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：進水Q=1000 m³/d、內回流Qr=2000 m³/d。公式 Qzone=Q+Qr；代入 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d。適用邊界：只計指定區域的循環水力負荷；外部排放仍須另作平衡。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: influentQ=1000 m³/d and internal recycleQr=2000 m³/d. Formula Qzone=Q+Qr; substitution 1000+2000 = 3000 m³/d. Boundary: Hydraulic throughput of one specified zone only; external discharge has a separate balance.
units.verify: 在流路圖分開標示內回流與真正出水，避免重複計量。在離線場景為「回流改善濕潤與水力代價」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Mark internal recycle separately from final effluent to avoid double counting. Build an offline evidence table for recycle wetting/hydraulic tradeoff; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把回流水加到整廠外部出水會造成假性水量增加。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Adding recycled flow to external effluent creates fictitious water production. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 內回流量越大等於淨產水越多。~Greater internal recycle means more net water production.
units.practice: 先點選「回流改善濕潤與水力代價」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qr改成3000 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4000 m³/d。與基準 3000 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the recycle wetting/hydraulic tradeoff measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qr to3000 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4000 m³/d. Compare with baseline 3000 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 通風供氧需求：通風氣量與可轉移氧量~Ventilation oxygen demand: Ventilation flow and transferable oxygen
units.mechanism: 進入濾床的氧氣只有一部分轉移到濕潤生物膜；空氣量足夠不代表分配均勻或氧已到達生物膜深處。本單元在「通風供氧需求」觀察此因果關係。~Only part of the oxygen entering a filter transfers to the wet biofilm; enough air volume does not prove uniform distribution or oxygen penetration. Examine this relationship at ventilation oxygen demand.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：同一參考溫壓下空氣500 m³/h、含氧質量0.28 kg/m³、假設轉移比例0.10。公式 Otransfer=Qair cO2 ftransfer；代入 500*0.28*0.10 = 14 kg O₂/h。適用邊界：教學轉移比例須以實測校正；自然通風隨氣溫與濾床阻力變化，不能保證固定風量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: air500 m³/h at one reference state, oxygen content0.28 kg/m³ and assumed transfer fraction0.10. Formula Otransfer=Qair cO2 ftransfer; substitution 500*0.28*0.10 = 14 kg O₂/h. Boundary: The hypothetical transfer fraction requires measurement; natural ventilation varies with temperature and bed resistance, so airflow is not guaranteed constant.
units.verify: 比較進出氣氧量與溫壓，觀察排水層、通氣口及濾床含水分布。在離線場景為「通風供氧需求」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Compare inlet/outlet oxygen on matched pressure/temperature bases and inspect underdrains, vents and bed wetting. Build an offline evidence table for ventilation oxygen demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 積水堵住通氣路徑會限制供氧；先診斷排水與通風阻力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Ponding can obstruct ventilation and limit oxygen; diagnose drainage and airflow resistance first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 空氣中含氧就表示生物膜每一層都不缺氧。~Oxygen in air means every biofilm layer is adequately oxygenated.
units.practice: 先點選「通風供氧需求」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把轉移比例改成0.06，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 8.4 kg O₂/h。與基準 14 kg O₂/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the ventilation oxygen demand measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only transfer fraction to0.06 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 8.4 kg O₂/h. Compare with baseline 14 kg O₂/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 溶解有機物去除驗證：去除效率與質量去向~Dissolved-organic removal evidence: Removal efficiency and mass destination
units.mechanism: 去除是污染物由水相移到污泥或被轉化；以相同流量比較濃度可估效率，但不能省略副產物流。本單元在「溶解有機物去除驗證」觀察此因果關係。~Removal moves pollutants from water to solids or transforms them; concentration comparison estimates efficiency at equal flows but does not eliminate residual streams. Examine this relationship at dissolved-organic removal evidence.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Cin=200 mg/L、Cout=40 mg/L且進出水量相同。公式 η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin；代入 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %。適用邊界：只適用同一物種、同時窗且等流量；不能代替總污染收支。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Cin=200 mg/L and Cout=40 mg/L at equal inlet and outlet flows. Formula η=100(Cin-Cout)/Cin; substitution 100*(200-40)/200 = 80 %. Boundary: Same species, time window and flow only; not a replacement for a complete pollutant balance.
units.verify: 同時量測污泥固體量與水相濃度，對照移除質量。在離線場景為「溶解有機物去除驗證」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Measure sludge solids and water concentrations together to reconcile removed mass. Build an offline evidence table for dissolved-organic removal evidence; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以清水稀釋取代處理會讓濃度變低但不一定減少排放質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Dilution can lower concentration without lowering discharge mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 看不到的污染物代表已完全被破壞。~An invisible pollutant has been completely destroyed.
units.practice: 先點選「溶解有機物去除驗證」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出水改成60 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 70 %。與基準 80 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the dissolved-organic removal evidence measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effluent to60 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 70 %. Compare with baseline 80 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 脫膜污泥與終沉：乾固體與含水率~Sloughed sludge/final settling: Dry solids and moisture
units.mechanism: 含水污泥總質量由乾固體庫存與固體分率決定；脫水主要移除水而非消滅固體。本單元在「脫膜污泥與終沉」觀察此因果關係。~Wet sludge mass follows dry-solids inventory and solids fraction; dewatering removes water rather than destroying solids. Examine this relationship at sloughed sludge/final settling.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：乾固體2000 kg/d、固體質量分率0.04。公式 Mwet=MDS/fDS；代入 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d。適用邊界：濃度採質量分率；若體積濃度須先確認密度。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: dry solids2000 kg/d and solids mass fraction0.04. Formula Mwet=MDS/fDS; substitution 2000/0.04 = 50000 kg/d. Boundary: Concentration is a mass fraction; volumetric concentration requires density.
units.verify: 秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「脫膜污泥與終沉」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for sloughed sludge/final settling; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 脫水後濕泥減少的質量全都是污染物被破壞。~All wet-mass reduction during dewatering is destroyed pollution.
units.practice: 先點選「脫膜污泥與終沉」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the sloughed sludge/final settling measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 布水不均與儀表檢查：感測器偏移校正~Uneven distribution/instrument checks: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「布水不均與儀表檢查」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at uneven distribution/instrument checks.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「布水不均與儀表檢查」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for uneven distribution/instrument checks; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「布水不均與儀表檢查」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the uneven distribution/instrument checks measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

history: EPA生物濾池資料描述介質、布水、通風與固體分離；名稱中的濾池不代表僅靠篩孔截留污染。地圖僅標示方法資料來源機構EPA總部的區域參考點，不表示此處設有本課處理廠。~EPA describes media, distribution, ventilation and solids separation; the word filter does not mean pollutants are removed only by sieving. The map marks the EPA headquarters area as a method-source institution, not a treatment plant for this lesson.
